verdict.rationale: Proton Pass ships an official CLI that lets scripts and pipelines securely retrieve secrets and read vault items. An agent can therefore query the vault programmatically without screen-scraping the app. However, the evidence shows no persistent local API or socket endpoint, and does not show that TOTP codes can be retrieved through the CLI. Missing for 10: a documented local server/API endpoint for agents, evidence of TOTP code retrieval via the programmatic surface, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app

citations.quote: the CLI enables you to securely retrieve secrets and other items across scripts, deployments, and continuous integration/ continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
View, create, update, and delete items including passwords, secure notes, credit cards, identities, WiFi entries, custom items, and stored SSH-key items
